headline: Borrowing approved for $10,149,973 airport building, Frost and South Lawrence East school roofs.
summary: The airport project is an administration building at Lawrence Municipal Airport. The Frost roof is at 33 Hamlet Street, and the South Lawrence East roof is at 165 Crawford Street. The school district's financial officer said the state's MSBA will cover 80% of the Frost costs. The city will spend $70,000 from Cataldo ambulance services money on the Lawrence Fire Department EMS coordinator salary.
decisions: Approved $10,149,973 in borrowing for the airport administration building.
Approved $7,881,647 in borrowing for the Frost Elementary School roof replacement.
Approved borrowing for the South Lawrence East Elementary School roof replacement.
Approved spending $70,000 from Cataldo ambulance services for the EMS coordinator salary.
Approved paying a prior year invoice of $40,316.80.
Tabled the $280 spending for deaf and hard of hearing awareness.
Approved naming the Lawrence Police Department community room for Lieutenant Charles M. Saindon.
Approved the appointment of Elvis A. Lora to the Lawrence Cultural Council.
Withdrew the Zoning Board appointment and the police executive assistant position.
Withdrew seven older Budget and Finance items as a block.
Ordered a public hearing on the Fiscal Year 2027 property tax classification.
Withdrew items 11-25 and 490-25 as a block.
Tabled the snow and ice operation ordinance change.
Approved handicap parking on Greenwood Street.
Approved handicap parking on Fairmont Street and Union Street.
Approved a National Grid pole on Marston Street at Brookline Street.
Continued the Highway Access 2 zoning public hearing to December 1.
Tabled the Highway Access 2 zoning item again.
discussion: House of Mercy tent site: Public speakers said the city ordered a tent site run by House of Mercy removed and said its owner faced fines of $1,200 a day. Speakers asked the council to help the group get permits and asked that opioid abatement funds go to it.

School roof bonds: The Lawrence Public Schools financial officer said the state's MSBA will cover 80% of the Frost project cost. The South Lawrence East roof work is planned to be bid in January and finished before the next school year starts.

Snow emergency ordinance: Members debated whether to order a public hearing before the language was ready. The Department of Public Works is proposing the change, and members said the new rules would start December the 15th.

Deaf awareness spending: Members asked whether the $280 needed a vote tonight, since the invoice was for an event that had already happened. The city attorney said the fines money must be used for handicap purposes and that the spending complied.

Police room naming: The city attorney said the naming corrects an error, because an ordinance requires council approval for namings. A member suggested that officers who died in the line of duty be recognized before other rooms are named.
